destination.note: The live witness journal: one comment per anchor verdict, appended by `anchor_witness.py publish`, never edited or deleted. It lives in a repository this project does not develop in, so its timestamps belong to the platform, not to the machine that signed the anchor. A gist also works if the token has the gist scope; the export rewrites this repository name back to the example one, so a publication tree points at its own journal.

note: Generate a purpose-limited, passphrase-free key (ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/loop_anchor_ed25519 -N ''), publish its public half in configs/allowed_signers, and point `destination` at a repository you do not develop in. The key proves the anchor was written by its holder; the external comment gives the digest a timestamp this machine cannot rewrite. `publish` and `check-external` are operator steps and are deliberately not required by the offline gate (D12 checks the signature and that a destination is declared).
